description: Dunit musl port (M6) fs: stat — POSIX stat() over the native Stat syscall. userspace/ctests/musl_stat.c stats a regular file (/app/musl_stat) and a directory (/persist); the adapter translates Dunit UserFileStat (type + size) into struct stat (st_mode type bits + st_size). Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_musl_stat_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 45 --timeout 160 --boot-timeout 110

required.claim: the system booted to the terminal
stat() on a file returned S_IFREG with a nonzero size via the native Stat -> struct stat adapter
the file is regular with size>0 and /persist stats as a directory — the stat adapter works
